description: This file defines the 'EventHubQueueCacheFactory' class which implements the 'IEventHubQueueCacheFactory' interface. It is responsible for creating and configuring instances of 'IEventHubQueueCache', including setting up buffer pools, cache pressure monitors, and cache instances with specific eviction strategies, tailored for Azure Event Hubs within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class to configure and create 'IEventHubQueueCache' instances, managing buffer pools, cache pressure, and eviction strategies for Event Hubs in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Creates and configures an 'IEventHubQueueCache' instance for a specific partition, including setting up buffer pool, pressure monitors, and eviction strategy.

methods.name: CreateBufferPool
methods.description: Configures the buffer pool used by the cache, allowing customization or overriding for specific buffer creation logic.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitors
methods.description: Adds cache pressure monitors based on provided options, allowing for configured monitoring of cache pressure conditions.

methods.name: CreateCache (protected virtual)
methods.description: Default implementation to instantiate an 'EventHubQueueCache' with provided parameters; can be overridden for custom cache creation.
